description: Looks up plain-language definitions of 60 digital-money terms for HR, finance and compliance teams (stablecoin, e-money token, payment token, multi-issuance, redemption, MiCA, GENIUS Act, Wage Protection System, Pay Transparency Directive, token grant, vesting and more), each with why it matters for HR and a link to the guide. Give a term or a word to search; leave it empty to list all terms. English or Spanish. Source: https://borbur.net/topics/digital-money-glossary/
